svg.title: A CPU spends area on control; a GPU spends it on lanes
svg.desc: Two panels. On the left, a schematic CPU: four large blue cores, a large green cache block and a gray control block for branch prediction and out-of-order execution, with no numbers because it is not to scale. On the right, the GTX 1650: 14 streaming multiprocessors in two rows of 7, each a tile of 64 small orange lanes, 896 in all, above one green L2 cache of 1,024 KB shared by every SM. The SM count and the L2 size are measured by device_query; the 64 lanes per SM are cited from the CUDA Programming Guide.
svg.text: A CPU spends area on control; a GPU spends it on lanes
GTX 1650 (compute capability 7.5), CUDA 12.3, October 2026: SMs and L2 measured; 64 lanes per SM cited.
Less control per thread, far more arithmetic: the GPU needs many threads to pay off.
